[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:388YE Summer]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Mharen Splitroot, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave">To construct the Nightingale Chorus wayhouse in Astolat. The wayhouse acts as a sinecure and increases tax in Astolat of one throne per season, and acts as a great work for Astolat, Weirwater, and Semmerholm. It boosts military units against the Vallorn. Election will be by Cat's Graces with the title of Conductor of the Nightingale Chorus.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[Navarr wayhouse|wayhouse]] in Brightway, Grovesyard, Astolat
* Announcement by the [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]
* More information can be found in the '''[[Ripple_of_echoes#Can't_Stop_The_Music|Ripple of echoes]]''' wind of fortune.

==Date==
* Summer 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 25 wains of white granite
* 10 wains of weirwood
* 105 crowns in labour costs 
* Three months to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Nightingale_Chorus}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the Nightingale Chorus will have the following effects:
* Increases investment in Astolat for military units engaged in the [[Venture#Quest_Against_the_Vallorn|Quest Against The Vallorn]]
* Increases the taxation of Astolat by 1 throne per season
* Allows Navarr to take a new personal resource in [[Astolat]] for free the season it is completed
* Creates a new [[Imperial title]], the ''Conductor of the Nightingale Chorus''
* Also increases investment in Weirwater and Semmerholm for the [[Venture#Quest_Against_the_Vallorn|Quest Against The Vallorn]], if the Dawnish Assembly names the fight against the vallorn to be their highest calling.
